title: Distribution Center Shipping Rule: Ship-Date Timing of Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Sensor Refills
content:
Distribution center shipping rule, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program (Larkfield Medical Supply).

## Scope

For a sensor refill (A4239) on a tier where each refill requires the customer's own confirmation, drawing on the authorization grant resting on the newest written order of the item, and only for such a refill, the earliest permitted ship date is set by the timing rules of this shipping rule; every other refill of the item ships no earlier than the tier's refill ship lead days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item, counted in calendar days: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is the tier's refill ship lead days before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed.

## Timing rules

For a refill within the scope above, these timing rules replace the standard earliest permitted ship date of the refill. They read the latest refill (the item's refill shipment with the latest ship date), the newest written order of the item (the one with the latest order date), the customer's Insulin Pump Program, from which the program's status and the pump delivery date recorded on it are read, and the latest refill's proof-of-delivery date: the delivery date of the latest delivery confirmation recorded for that refill shipment, or its ship date when no proof of delivery is recorded.

1. When the customer's Insulin Pump Program is not closed and the pump delivery falls after the latest refill shipped and on or before the newest written order's date, the latest refill does not count and the delivery may ship today. A customer with no Insulin Pump Program does not meet this rule.
2. When rule 1 does not hold and the latest refill shipped by expedited shipping at no charge, because Larkfield delayed it, the earliest date is the tier's refill ship lead days, in calendar days, before its proof-of-delivery date, or its ship date when no proof of delivery is recorded, plus its supply days.
3. Otherwise, that is when neither rule 1 nor rule 2 holds, the standard earliest date applies: the tier's refill ship lead days, in calendar days, before the latest refill's ship date plus its supply days.

## Refill ship lead days by tier

| Tier | Refill ship lead days (calendar days) | Within the scope above |
|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 7 | no — refills on this tier need no per-refill confirmation, so they are always "every other refill" |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 7 | yes |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 10 | yes |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 10 | yes |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 10 | yes |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 7 | yes |

## Rule 1 at its boundaries

| Insulin Pump Program | Pump delivery date | Rule 1 |
|---|---|---|
| open (any status other than closed) | after the latest refill's ship date and on the newest written order's date | holds — may ship today |
| open (any status other than closed) | after the latest refill's ship date and before the newest written order's date | holds — may ship today |
| open (any status other than closed) | after the newest written order's date | does not hold |
| open (any status other than closed) | on the latest refill's ship date | does not hold (not after it) |
| closed | any date | does not hold |
| none held | — | does not hold |

## Worked examples (hypothetical dates)

Suppose the tier is the CGM Commercial PPO Program (10 lead days) and the latest refill shipped on a hypothetical 1 March with 90 days of supply.

- Expedited at no charge, proof of delivery 6 March: 6 March plus 90 days is 4 June; 10 days before is 25 May, the earliest permitted ship date.
- Same refill shipped by standard ground: rule 3 applies. 1 March plus 90 days is 30 May; 10 days before is 20 May, the earliest permitted ship date.
- Expedited at no charge with no proof of delivery recorded: the ship date stands in, so the earliest permitted ship date is again 20 May.
- Pump delivered on the customer's open Insulin Pump Program on 20 March, newest written order dated 22 March: rule 1 holds, the latest refill does not count, and the delivery may ship today, whatever the shipping method of that refill.
